name: In the Doghouse
source:
A straightforward short visual novel about a human finding a mysterious cafe run by six dogs! They look a bit different from normal dogs....

[From [url=https://rasenth.itch.io/in-the-doghouse]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部直截了当的短篇视觉小说，讲述了一个人类发现一家由六只狗经营的神秘咖啡馆的故事！它们看起来和普通的狗有点不一样……

[来自[url=https://rasenth.itch.io/in-the-doghouse]itch.io[/url]]
